svg.title: Formalism numerical witness workbench
svg.desc: All typed deterministic numerical witnesses are plotted from their declared schemas with residual, tolerance, theorem-mirror, unit, and boundary summaries. The visible boundary label identifies these diagnostics as non-proof evidence.
svg.text: 16 typed witnesses · 16 formal families · exact evaluated schemas
Deterministic numerical witnesses are explanatory non-proof evidence. They can expose finite sign, normalization, support, rank,
identity, and contraction errors; they are neither Lean proof receipts nor empirical validation of the Free Energy Principle.

g.aria-label: Finite posterior reconstruction, accepted, Theorem Instance
g.title: Finite posterior reconstruction · measure-bayes-reconstruction · measure-bayesian-inversion
g.desc: posterior(x|y) * predictive(y) = prior(x) * likelihood(y|x) Boundary: A third impossible evidence atom has zero predictive mass. Theorem mirrors: FEP.MeasureBayes.finite_posterior_reconstruction, FEP.MeasureBayes.finite_zero_evidence_boundary Formal alignment: theorem_instance. Typed checks: posterior-reconstruction: eq(0.0, 0.0), tolerance 1e-12, residual 0.0, accepted.

g.aria-label: Fin-2 categorical Fisher energy and duplicated-score boundary, accepted, Theorem Instance
g.title: Fin-2 categorical Fisher energy and duplicated-score boundary · categorical-fisher-rank · information-geometry-and-geometric-optimization
g.desc: The nonzero Fin-2 simplex tangent has Fisher energy four, while the duplicated fair-Bernoulli score Gram matrix has determinant zero. Boundary: The explicit nonzero categorical tangent has positive energy; duplicating the fair-Bernoulli score direction makes the coordinate Gram determinant zero. Theorem mirrors: FEP.GeometricOptimization.twoCategorical_nonzeroTangent_metric, FEP.GeometricOptimization.twoCategorical_simplexMetric_fullRank, FEP.InformationGeometry.duplicatedFairBernoulli_fisherMatrix_entry, FEP.InformationGeometry.duplicatedFairBernoulli_not_identifiable Formal alignment: theorem_instance. Typed checks: fisher-rank-certificates: eq(0.0, 0.0), tolerance 1e-12, residual 0.0, accepted.

g.aria-label: Finite Laplace-smoothed Brier-risk transfer, accepted, Theorem Instance
g.title: Finite Laplace-smoothed Brier-risk transfer · laplace-brier-risk · finite-sample-risk-and-calibration
g.desc: Bernoulli Brier excess equals squared forecast error and the finite-law Laplace risk stays below its transfer bound Boundary: At sample count two and target zero, add-one smoothing has exact bias one quarter rather than silently becoming unbiased. g.aria-label: Exact Boltzmann EFE floor, perception chain rule, and affinity-bounded gain, accepted, Theorem Instance
g.title: Exact Boltzmann EFE floor, perception chain rule, and affinity-bounded gain · boltzmann-efe-affinity-gap · standalone-efe-formalizations
g.desc: the KL-regularized EFE objective attains exactly the inverse-precision log-partition floor at the Boltzmann control posterior with inverse-precision KL gaps, the perception channel splits the belief information gap exactly into outcome-marginal plus posterior-averaged parts without increasing it, and the two-state epistemic gain is the relaxation-decaying KL bounded by the affinity production rate Boundary: At time zero the identity kernel returns the full belief gap 0.0610605352, the squared-relaxation envelope 0.1071428571 stays loose by 0.0460823220, and the affinity bound 0.1330954793 leaves slack 0.0720349441. Theorem mirrors: fep_fep156.FEP156.fep156_boltzmann_control_posterior_minimizes_efe, fep_fep156.FEP156.fep156_boltzmann_control_posterior_minimal_value, fep_fep156.FEP156.fep156_efeControlObjective_eq_kl_sub_logPartition, fep_fep156.FEP156.fep156_efeControlObjective_sub_eq_kl, fep_fep157.FEP157.fep157_perception_kl_decomposition, fep_fep157.FEP157.fep157_perception_step_kl_nonincrease, fep_fep158.FEP158.fep158_reduction_free_energy_change_eq_kl, fep_fep159.FEP159.fep159_epistemic_gain_bounded_by_affinity, fep_fep159.FEP159.fep159_expectedFreeEnergy_le_productionRate_div_decayRate, fep_fep159.FEP159.fep159_slow_fast_separation_statement, fep_fep159.FEP159.fep159_productionRate_nonneg Formal alignment: theorem_instance. Typed checks: control-floor-identity: eq(0.0, 0.0), tolerance 1e-12, residual 0.0, accepted; control-gap-identity: eq(5.551115123125783e-17, 0.0), tolerance 1e-12, residual 5.551115123125783e-17, accepted; donsker-varadhan-gap: eq(1.1102230246251565e-16, 0.0), tolerance 1e-12, residual 1.1102230246251565e-16, accepted; control-posterior-minimality: predicate(True, True), tolerance 0.0, residual 0.0, accepted; perception-chain-rule: eq(1.6653345369377348e-16, 0.0), tolerance 1e-12, residual 1.6653345369377348e-16, accepted; perception-nonincrease: le(0.2148611968468687, 0.3347952867143343), tolerance 1e-12, residual 0.0, accepted; affinity-production-bound: le(0.0, 0.0), tolerance 1e-12, residual 0.0, accepted; squared-relaxation-envelope: le(0.0, 0.0), tolerance 1e-12, residual 0.0, accepted; production-rate-nonnegative: predicate(True, True), tolerance 0.0, residual 0.0, accepted.
